items.stem: Why link the three financial statements rather than build them independently?

options.text: Because they share figures (for example net income flows to retained earnings and cash)

options.text: Because ratios cannot be computed otherwise

Correct: the quick ratio is a stricter liquidity measure.

items.stem: What should you always do before publishing a Copilot-written variance narrative?

options.text: Check every claim in it against the underlying numbers
options.rationale: Correct: AI commentary must be verified against the source data.

options.text: Delete the source data to save space
options.rationale: Never delete the source; you need it to verify.

options.text: Assume it is correct because it is detailed
options.rationale: Detail is not evidence of correctness.

options.text: Translate it into another language first

items.explanation: Correct: verify every claim in a Copilot narrative against the underlying numbers before publishing.
